title: Event Clusterer — Input Article Record
description: One JSON object per line in news_cache.jsonl. Produced by book_arm/pai_modules/global_ingestor.py from the 492-source ingest set. Schema reflects the live file shape as of 2026-05-10 (sampled from book_arm/memory/news_cache.jsonl, 11,812 entries). The clusterer reads headline + hash + source; other fields are passed through downstream.

hash.description: Content hash, used as article primary key during clustering and downstream re-joining.

headline.description: Article headline. Entity extraction runs against this field.

source.description: Source identifier (e.g. 'scmp', 'rt', 'reuters'). Matches keys in data/source_registry.json.

source_name.description: Human-readable source name. Optional; falls back to 'source' field at render time.
